//! wow64_cb_automarshal — @generated by `tools/codegen marshal gen-callback`. DO NOT EDIT.
//!
//! 64<->32 marshallers for win32k WINDOWPROC callback payloads (the KeUserModeCallback
//! direction). Field offsets come from clang record-layout dumps at both the 32-bit and
//! the 64-bit Windows targets. wow64_callback dispatches Down/Up around the guest call.
//! The same walk writes dll/win32/wow64/wow64_cb_automarshal.{c,h}, the pre-port C.
//!
//! Regenerate:  tools/codegen marshal gen-callback

use core::ffi::{c_uchar, c_uint};

pub type ULONG = u32;
pub type LONG = i32;
pub type LONGLONG = i64;

#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowCbCpy(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8, n: usize) {
    core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(s, d, n)
}

#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowCbZero(d: *mut u8, n: usize) {
    core::ptr::write_bytes(d, 0, n)
}

/// 4 -> 8 sign-extend (handles: pseudo/special values like HWND_TOPMOST(-1) are only
/// correct sign-extended).
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowCbSx(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8) {
    let w = (s as *const i32).read_unaligned() as i64;
    (d as *mut i64).write_unaligned(w)
}

/// 8 -> 4 narrow.
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowCbNx(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8) {
    WowCbCpy(d, s, 4)
}

pub type WOW64_CB_MARSHAL_FN = unsafe extern "C" fn(*const c_uchar, *mut c_uchar);

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct _WOW64_CB_MARSHAL {
    pub Msg: c_uint,
    pub Size32: c_uint,
    pub Size64: c_uint,
    pub Down: Option<WOW64_CB_MARSHAL_FN>,
    pub Up: Option<WOW64_CB_MARSHAL_FN>,
}
pub type WOW64_CB_MARSHAL = _WOW64_CB_MARSHAL;
pub type PWOW64_CB_MARSHAL = *mut WOW64_CB_MARSHAL;
